mcq.QUESTION_DESC: The Fourier cosine transform of \(e^{-ax}, a>0\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(F_c(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} \cos(sx) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{e^{-ax}}{a^2+s^2} (-a\cos(sx) + s\sin(sx)) \right]_{0}^{\infty}\)

(3 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left[ 0 - \frac{1}{a^2+s^2} (-a) \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{a}{a^2+s^2}\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier cosine transform of } f(x)=e^{-ax}, a>0.\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(F_s(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} \sin(sx) dx\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{e^{-ax}}{a^2+s^2} (-a\sin(sx) - s\cos(sx)) \right]_{0}^{\infty}\)

(3 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \left[ 0 - \frac{1}{a^2+s^2} (-s) \right]\)

(2 Mark)

\(= \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{s}{a^2+s^2}\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier sine transform of } f(x)=e^{-ax}, a>0.\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
\(F_c(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} \cos(sx) dx\)(2)
Using integration: \(\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} \cos(sx) dx = \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(3)
Thus \(F_c(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(3)
Alternatively, evaluate: \(\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-ax} \cos(sx) dx = \left[ \frac{e^{-ax}}{a^2 + s^2} (-a \cos(sx) + s \sin(sx)) \right]_{0}^{\infty}\)(3)
\(= 0 - \frac{1}{a^2 + s^2} (-a) = \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(2)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier cosine transform of } f(x)=e^{-ax}, a>0.\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
Using property: \(F_s[xf(x)] = -\frac{d}{ds} F_c[f(x)]\)(3)
We know \(F_c[e^{-ax}] = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{a}{a^2 + s^2}\)(2)
Differentiate: \(\frac{d}{ds} F_c[e^{-ax}] = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{-2as}{(a^2 + s^2)^2}\)(3)
Thus \(F_s[xe^{-ax}] = -\frac{d}{ds} F_c[e^{-ax}] = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \cdot \frac{2as}{(a^2 + s^2)^2}\)(4)
Direct integration also gives: \(\int_{0}^{\infty} x e^{-ax} \sin(sx) dx = \frac{2as}{(a^2 + s^2)^2}\)(3)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the Fourier sine transform of } f(x)=xe^{-ax}, a>0.\)
